Support the gallery

To keep our doors open & free to the public, we rely on the financial support from individuals, trusts and foundations to present an ambitious programme of exhibitions, screening, events and learning activities, in addition to the core funding from Arts Council England and Southwark Council.

There are many ways of supporting us; starting or building your own art collections by purchasing artworks or limited editions from our online shop, sponsoring a project, donations, or becoming a member of our supporter’s circle

Green Shoots! Family Workshops
17 May - 25 October 2026

Sunday Mornings, 10am-1pm   //   Garden & Bothy

Make eco-friendly artworks in our community garden!


Join us Sunday and select Wednesday mornings, 10am – 1pm, for free, artist-led creative workshops for families with children up to 12 years old.

Create eco-conscious art delivered by artists with the environment at the core of their professional practice. 

Embrace a love of nature, spark your creativity, and feel the wellbeing benefits of connecting with your local community in our beautiful garden setting.

Summer Holiday dates:
Sun 26 July, Wed 29 July, Sun 2 August, Wed 5 August, Sun 9 August, Sun 16 August, Wed 19 August, Sun 23 August, Wed 26 August, Sun 30 August

  • Drop-in between 10am-1pm, no booking required.
  • Sessions are free and welcome to all families and carers with children (0 – 12).
  • Please note children must be accompanied by an adult.
  • Find us at Southwark Park Galleries, Lake Gallery Garden. Check where to find us here.

Sign up to our Online Mailing list to hear directly about our upcoming family workshops and events.

Southwark Park Galleries is part of the London Happier Outdoors Network for organisations and individuals who are involved or interested in green and blue social prescribing in Greater London. Please get in touch if you’d like to know more or have any questions.

Green Shoots! Free Creative Family Workshops is made possible thanks to the National Lottery Community Fund and Albion Street Community Charity / Up Market
